moves.name: Close Combat
moves.description:
Fighting (Physical)
Base Power: 120
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.

moves.name: Fake Out
moves.description:
Normal (Physical)
Base Power: 40
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 3
Has a 100% chance to make the target flinch. Fails unless it is the user's first turn on the field.

moves.name: Dire Claw
moves.description:
Poison (Physical)
Base Power: 80
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 50% chance to cause the target to either fall asleep, become poisoned, or become paralyzed.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 4
The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

moves.name: Poison Jab
moves.description:
Poison (Physical)
Base Power: 80
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 30% chance to poison the target.

moves.name: Quick Guard
moves.description:
Fighting (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 3
The user and its party members are protected from attacks with original or altered priority greater than 0 made by other Pokemon, including allies, during this turn. This move modifies the same 1/X chance of being successful used by other protection moves, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used, but does not use the chance to check for failure. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn or if this move is already in effect for the user's side.

moves.name: Rock Slide

Rock (Physical)

Accuracy: 90

moves.name: Coaching
moves.description:
Fighting (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
Raises the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user.

moves.name: Gunk Shot
moves.description:
Poison (Physical)
Base Power: 120
Accuracy: 80
Priority: 0
Has a 30% chance to poison the target.

moves.name: Feint
moves.description:
Normal (Physical)
Base Power: 30
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 2
If this move is successful, it breaks through the target's Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, or Spiky Shield for this turn, allowing other Pokemon to attack the target normally. If the target's side is protected by Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard, that protection is also broken for this turn and other Pokemon may attack the target's side normally.

items.name: Focus Sash
items.description: If holder's HP is full, will survive an attack that would KO it with 1 HP. Single use.

items.name: White Herb
items.description: Restores all lowered stat stages to 0 when one is less than 0. Single use.

items.name: Life Orb
items.description: Holder's attacks do 1.3x damage, and it loses 1/10 its max HP after the attack.

items.name: Iron Ball
items.description: Holder is grounded, Speed halved. If Flying type, takes neutral Ground damage.

items.name: Mental Herb
items.description: Cures holder of Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, Torment. Single use.

items.name: Lum Berry
items.description: Holder cures itself if it has a non-volatile status or is confused. Single use.

items.name: Expert Belt
items.description: Holder's attacks that are super effective against the target do 1.2x damage.

items.name: Sitrus Berry
items.description: Restores 1/4 max HP when at 1/2 max HP or less. Single use.

items.name: King's Rock
items.description: Holder's attacks without a chance to make the target flinch gain a 10% chance to make the target flinch. Evolves Poliwhirl into Politoed and Slowpoke into Slowking when traded.

abilities.name: Unburden
abilities.description: If this Pokemon loses its held item for any reason, its Speed is doubled as long as it remains active, has this Ability, and is not holding an item.

abilities.name: Poison Touch
abilities.description: This Pokemon's contact moves have a 30% chance of poisoning. This effect comes after a move's inherent secondary effect chance.

abilities.name: Pressure
abilities.description: If this Pokemon is the target of an opposing Pokemon's move, that move loses one additional PP. Imprison, Snatch, and Tera Blast also lose one additional PP when used by an opposing Pokemon, but Sticky Web does not.
